remarks: Charming and updated 1-bedroom corner condo in sought-after Glen Royal! This inviting home features an open floor plan with beautiful hardwood floors throughout, extra-tall ceilings, elegant arched hallways, and abundant natural light. The updated kitchen is appointed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and recessed lighting, creating the perfect blend of style and functionality. Renovated bath adds to the home's modern appeal. Ideally located just 1.2 miles from the Stamford train station and within close proximity to vibrant Downtown Stamford, offering easy access to shops, restaurants, bars, and public transportation. Enjoy the value of low common charges in this well-maintained building, which include heat, hot water, water, sewer, and trash. One assigned parking space and additional storage unit included.
